evidence.source: CORRECTION. This record stated 189 and hosted Development holds 190. Measured on 18 August 2026 by an independent read-only query against project iouzoutneyjpugbbtdem that NAMES the ledger row rather than counting alone: 190 rows with the newest being 20260814005000 ai_actionable_bet_evidence, which is the same head Production carries. THE APPLYING RUN IS NOT IDENTIFIED. No workflow run in this repository applied it: the most recent Development fast lane is run 31751114401 of 13 August 2026, which the superseded record cites for contract 189, and contract 190 is dated 20260814005000. development-migration-rollout.yml has never run. So contract 190 reached Development by a route this repository does not record, most plausibly a direct operator apply made so that Production would not be the first hosted environment to see it - but that is inference and is NOT recorded here as fact. The count and the named row are measured; the provenance is not, and this record says so rather than inventing a run id. The rest of the environment was measured in the same read: 24 auth users, 24 profiles, 34 entries, 756 match predictions, 64 season predictions, 8 settled matchweek scores, 5 leagues, 39 league members, 578 season fixtures, 20 competition entrants, 0 bonus score events, 9 player action items, 14 cron jobs and the Euro publication state still hidden. PAID COLLECTION REMAINS DISABLED IN DEVELOPMENT: ai.api_budget.collection_enabled is false and ai.api_usage holds 0 rows, unchanged from the superseded record. One Predictor Championship is launched there - private, tournament-scoped, format_kind single_group, 8 entrants, 112 fixtures - and it is entirely in its group stage, every fixture stage group and every member phase_kind initial, so admin_finalise_predictor_cup_groups has not run on it. Contracts 191 to 198 are NOT applied: zero of the five new authenticated reads exist and process_player_action_items calls two of the four generators. This is database state only and claims no application publication.
